item.title: rock skip
item.description: Skip a tiny stone across the water. Click and drag to set angle and power, release to throw. Exactly 7 skips to win - no more, no less.

item.title: labyrinth
item.description: Guide the tiny marble through the maze by tilting. Move your mouse to tilt the board. Don’t fall in the holes. Reach the cyan goal to win.

item.title: connect 4
item.description: Drop discs to get 4 in a row. Classic strategy in 35x30 pixels. The AI makes mistakes sometimes.

item.title: jumping ant
item.description: Bounce upward on platforms. Move left/right with mouse or touch. 28x50 pixels of vertical adventure.

item.title: memory
item.description: Match all 8 pairs without clicking a card you’ve already seen (unless it’s the match).

item.title: simon
item.description: Watch the colored quadrants light up, then repeat the sequence. 4 colors in 40x40 pixels. Each round adds one more to remember. Click to start.

item.title: whack-a-mole
item.description: Moles pop up from 9 holes in a 44x44 pixel grid. Tap them before they disappear. Miss 3 and it’s game over. Speed increases as you play.

item.title: flappy ant
item.description: Tap or click to flap through the pipes. 40x56 pixels of frustration. The ant is 3 pixels. Good luck.

item.title: minesweeper
item.description: 6x6 grid with 6 hidden mines in 42x42 pixels. Click to reveal, right-click to flag. Numbers show adjacent mine count. Don’t click a mine.

item.title: breakout
item.description: Break all the bricks with your ball. 4 rows of 6 bricks, 3 lives, 48x56 pixels of arcade action. Move paddle with mouse or touch.

item.title: checkers
item.description: Full 8x8 checkers board in 48x48 pixels. Click a red piece to select, then click a highlighted square to move. Jumps are mandatory. Double-click to reset.

item.title: pong
item.description: The original video game, now microscopic at 50x32 pixels. Move your paddle with mouse or touch to deflect the ball. First to 5 wins.

item.title: snake
item.description: Guide the tiny snake to eat food and grow. Don’t hit the walls or yourself. Uses a 10x10 grid in just 40x40 pixels. Click to focus, then use WASD or arrow keys.

item.title: tic-tac-toe
item.description: The classic game of Xs and Os, shrunk down to 36x36 pixels. You play as X against a simple AI. Click any empty cell to place your mark. Click to reset after game ends.
